verdict.reasons: Core defect: The irrigation evidence is completely disconnected from the product. The drip tape lateral emerges directly from a pressure gauge that is physically attached to a tomato fruit on the plant stem, which is impossible and does not match the technical intent of testing line pressure on an installed system. This severe technical mismatch prevents the image from being a useful editorial illustration despite the correct product identification.

focused_physical_review.reason: The black irrigation line emerges directly from the base of the white-and-blue AFP carton, physically touching the package footprint rather than crossing over it. Additionally, there is a distinct, separate loose coil of tubing resting on the soil to the right of the carton, which is a separate uninstalled object and not a continuous installed lateral.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
Independent physical condition not met: line_touches_or_crosses_package
Independent physical condition not met: extra_loose_product_coil
